dangerous_compensators_present.vmax_VPEP_PASE: VPEP_PASE provides an ADP-independent escape from PEP to PYR. It can mask a real VENOPGM or VPK bottleneck. Open it only late and under tight bounds.

stage_outline.name: anchor_priority_1
stage_outline.purpose: Stabilise Priority 1 physiological anchors — energy core, glucose commitment, lactate outlet, redox.
notes: Keep VPEP_PASE and secondary VE* exports closed in this stage.

stage_outline.name: glycolysis_priority_2
stage_outline.purpose: Refine internal glycolysis intermediates once Priority 1 behaviour is credible.
notes: Expect VPFK, VFDPA, VENOPGM, VPK to dominate this stage.
Some MM auto-added parameters were dropped because the dataset does not support them: vmax_VADSL, vmax_VAMPD1, vmax_VAPRT.
Dangerous compensator parameters were selected by the user: vmax_VPEP_PASE. They are still included, but triage will flag any run where they dominate the fit.
rationale: Extracellular anchors are measured alongside Priority 1 metabolites, so we use the full glycolysis_extracellular objective bundle and stage Vmax before Km to stabilise transport + commitment before fine affinity tuning.
